<details>
<summary>unrelated typo in same file</summary>

And just a heads up, in looking for good "error" text to build the fix error text from, I think there is a simple mistake/typo around a similar length check for lightmap storage in the same file.

```cpp
void LightStorage::lightmap_set_textures(RID p_lightmap, RID p_light, bool p_uses_spherical_haromics) {
...
ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(lm->array_index < 0, "Maximum amount of lightmaps in use (" + itos(lightmap_textures.size()) + ") has been exceeded, lightmap will nod display properly.");
...
}
```

"lightmap will **nod** display properly", i imagine this was supposed to be "not".
</details>

> I can't reproduce this on 4.5.dev

Interesting, curious if you could try putting some even more egregious amount of probes and see if you can get a crash that way?
Re-opening my MRP now it doesn't cause a crash instantly, and I was able to place an extra few probes and move them all around a few times to force them to rebake, but after doing that a few times I did get the editor to crash again.

> Interesting, curious if you could try putting some even more egregious amount of probes and see if you can get a crash that way? Re-opening my MRP now it doesn't cause a crash instantly, and I was able to place an extra few probes and move them all around a few times to force them to rebake, but after doing that a few times I did get the editor to crash again.

I didn't see in the description that I had to place one more ReflectionProbe for it to crash. I've done that and it crashes now, but only after adding enough probes.

**Edit:** The MRP has `reflections/reflection_atlas/reflection_count=114` in the Project Settings, which is why it doesn't crash when you add 65 reflection probes.

Either way, this is fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104302.

> The MRP has reflections/reflection_atlas/reflection_count=114 in the Project Settings, which is why it doesn't crash when you add 65 reflection probes.

Ah oops my bad, I thought I put it back to default. Thanks for testing again!
